items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: Yeah, yeah, I played with Andrew. Andrew played with Thomas. ... I had to kick him on the feet for sitting up there sleeping. While the band playing

ctx.x: Which Sam Morgan band was that? Was that the first one or the second one?
Well, they had, at that time, let's see, he had Sam, his brother Isaiah, and they had Andrew.
